business_summary: Uluru.Co.,Ltd. provides crowd generated, business process outsourcing (BPO), and crowdsourcing services in Japan. It operates through Crowd Generated Service (CGS) Business Nyusatsu Joho Sokuho Service (NJSS), CGS Business Fondesk, CGS Business Photo, CGS Business Others, BPO Business, and Crowdsourcing Business segments. The company offers NJSS, a bid solicitations database service; nSearch, a public-sector contract bidding information service; EnPhoto, a photo sales management system for nursery schools and kindergartens; fondesk, a telephone answering service for companies or offices; OurPhoto, a matching service for professional photographers; and entry automation system (EAS), a SaaS-type input service that combines artificial intelligence-based OCR and human power to digitize data. It also provides BPO services, including outsourcing services for data entry and scanning; and Ururu BPO, a service that utilizes human resources to provide solutions in the areas of DX, digitization, BPR, and backend of SaaS. In addition, the company offers crowdsourcing services comprising the Shufti platform, which matches clients who want to outsource work with crowd workers. Further, it produces and sells graduation albums for elementary and junior high schools. Uluru.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
